hops.summary:
Accept; no blocking Findings. I reviewed candidate 374c78b against the original BP3 contracts (wfc-beta1-bp3-init-plan-commit-001) and the remediation contracts (wfc-beta1-bp3-remediation-001), not against the predecessor report: 1bbc0c2 and the archived Run were read as context only and carry no credit here. Every claim was produced in this Hop by driving production entry points (frontdoor.cli:main and git_facts.bounded_path_commit) against disposable from-scratch consumer Git repositories outside the reviewed checkout, and each criterion was measured twice -- on the candidate and on a pre-fix tree (git archive of 374c78b with the three implementation files replaced by their 1e08d77 versions, confirmed by the absence of git_facts.repository_head).

I reproduced all three original violations on the pre-fix tree and showed each corrected on the candidate. R1: pre-fix, `wfc plan` exits 0 while executing a configured core.fsmonitor helper twice and the helper writes a worktree file; on the candidate 9/9 probe checks pass -- no fsmonitor helper and no core.hooksPath hook runs, HEAD, raw .git/index bytes and a full worktree byte+mode snapshot are identical, the project check never executes, no Commission is written, and the printed guidance_commit equals the pre-invocation HEAD so the default lookup really was reached; a positive control shows the same fixture does fire the helper for a plain `git status`. R4: pre-fix, absolute, ../ traversal and symlinked-parent forms each exit 0 and write the Consumer Config outside the repository; on the candidate 36/36 checks pass across seven escape forms (including /etc, a home-directory absolute path, a symlinked final component and nested/../../outside), all refused with exit 2, empty stdout and zero mutation outside, inside, in the index or in status, while valid nested/default init, no-clobber refusal and repo-root identity resolution are preserved. R2: pre-fix, the pre-`git add` swap returns success and publishes a commit with tree entry `120000 blob` pointing outside the repository; on the candidate it is refused before publication with HEAD unchanged, no commit in rev-list --all, the intent subject absent from git log --all, no reachable blob containing the attacker content or path, and the residue is exactly one staged, uncommitted 120000 index entry that the error message discloses. I also probed the boundary after the staged-mode inspection: a commit is published there, but it carries the validated content at mode 100644 and the call still fails closed, which is why the guard's placement is sound rather than merely narrow. Preserved protections verified directly: authorized new-leaf success, preexisting-symlink refusal, clean/process-filter refusal with the filter unexecuted, and hooks never running on the bounded-commit path (with an ordinary git commit as positive control). No general race-freedom guarantee is claimed or required.

No existing assertion was weakened (both test files and git_facts.py are purely additive; the eight changed leaves are all inside Commission scope; withheld surfaces are untouched), the five added tests fail on the pre-fix tree and pass on the candidate, and the documentation changes state implementation with review and task-check outstanding rather than acceptance or closure.

Four non-blocking observations are recorded in the artifact, not as Finding deltas: N1 the guard validates staged mode, not content, so a regular-file content swap in the same window still publishes (identical pre-fix, and outside the symlink-specific criterion); N2 an unresolvable in-repository parent (self-referential symlink, or an existing regular file as parent) yields an uncaught FileExistsError instead of exit 2, with no escape and no write, on code lines outside the diff; N3 R1 is fixed on the plan path while _readonly_git's shared observation seam still inherits ordinary Git policy for other callers, which this Commission's scope withholds; N4 init's normalization is slightly laxer than git_facts._normalized_path (silently accepting a//b.yaml, ./rel.yaml) and a degenerate empty NewPathCommitIntent makes the new guard list the whole index, producing a misleading message while still failing closed. N4 was not reported by the predecessor review.

The current Run carries no authoritative Findings, so I submit no Finding delta: R1/R4/R2 are cited as historical provenance and evidence only, and the gate's resolve authority is left unused. Limits: all results above are agent-side exploratory validation, not Coordinator-trusted evidence, and the full task-check remains independently mandatory. The required suite refuses to run without WFC_TEST_INPUTS/WFC_TEST_PROFILE, so every pytest run was an explicitly flagged --wfc-partial subset; in tests/unit + tests/architecture 1067 passed with 28 failures and 13 errors confined to four files that are absent from the diff and do not import frontdoor or git_facts, caused by agent-local sandbox limits (offline nested pip install cannot fetch setuptools>=68; a read-only /tmp blocks the claude adapter's scratch symlink). I did not relax sandbox or network settings and do not classify those as product defects. All probe fixtures and the pre-fix export were deleted; the reviewed checkout's only change is the new durable artifact, HEAD is still b46d181, and I made no Git writes.
